acceptance: A lane that changes only go/internal/<pkg>/testdata/<file> runs that package's tests in its floor, proven by a test through the real floor entry point that is red without the change
cover-changed does not select a package only because a non-.go file in it changed
fix: Design first: map a changed non-.go file under go/ to its package through changedpkgs.PatternOf and add that package to the unit-test floor without adding it to cover-changed; red test through the real floor entry point; 100% coverage of changed functions.
summary: The build floor keeps only changed .go paths (go/internal/core/phase_bindings_selfcheck.go:66), so a lane that changes only go/<pkg>/testdata/* or an embedded file under go/ runs no test of that package. Split out of docs/plans/data-file-test-floor-2026-11.md (component C5 left that plan's scope because the fix touches floorTestPackages and cover-changed).
title: The floor runs the tests of a package whose testdata or embed file changed
